intro: This errand delivers word of a disastrous dinosaur attack at the Whelgar's Excavation site back to Menethil Harbor. Merrin Rockweaver writes a hasty letter to reassure her anxious husband, Tarrel, while recounting how the expedition was overrun.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It was horrible! We were uncovering some rare artifacts and we began to discover these large bones.
Before we knew what was happening, these Mottled Raptors overwhelmed the dig site. Many lives were lost.
Ormer here—so brave—saved the Prospector and me. He defended us as we ran for shelter. Now we are trapped. And our hard work lies in ruin.
Here, take this note back to my sweet Tarrel. It will explain the situation to him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to find Merrin? Did she send word?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Such horrible news! At least 3 of them survived. But when will the killing end? I long for the day when King Magni's subjects can live without fear.
